questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Our class is carrying empty boxes into the storage room after a fair. I hear my name and turn round before moving any farther. Maya is standing behind me with a loose shoelace trailing on the floor. She puts her box down so that she will not fall down while walking. I hold it steady as she ties the lace and checks the other shoe. Then we make sure the doorway is clear before lifting both boxes again. The work takes a little longer, but we finish without a dropped box or an injury." This supports the answer: "Taking a little time to finish a job safely".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：义卖后，我们班把空箱子搬进储藏室。 听见有人叫我的名字，我先转过身，没有再往前走。 玛雅站在我后面，松开的鞋带拖在地上。 她放下箱子，免得走路时跌倒。 她系鞋带、检查另一只鞋时，我帮她扶稳箱子。 然后，我们确认门口没有障碍，再次抬起两个箱子。 工作稍微慢了一点，但没有掉箱子，也没人受伤。 因此正确选项为“Taking a little time to finish a job safely”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A River Walk Paused to Help a Dog”. Evidence: On Sunday mornings, our neighbours take exercise together beside the river. One morning, they stop when they hear a small dog barking below the path. Its lead is caught on a low branch near the fast water. The dog is in danger, and nobody wants to make it jump towards the river. The group stays back while one neighbour calls a trained rescue worker. The worker frees the lead and brings the frightened dog onto the path. Soon its owner arrives, thanks everyone and takes it home on a shorter lead.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A River Walk Paused to Help a Dog”。原文依据：星期天早上，邻居们一起在河边锻炼。 一天早上，他们听到小狗在小路下方叫，便停下来。 它的牵引绳挂在急流旁的一根低树枝上。 狗处于危险中，大家都不想惊得它跳向河里。 大家退后，一位邻居联系受过训练的救援人员。 救援人员解开牵引绳，把受惊的狗带到小路上。 很快，主人赶来向大家道谢，用更短的牵引绳带它回家。

passages.text: Our class is carrying empty boxes into the storage room after a fair. I hear my name and turn round before moving any farther. Maya is standing behind me with a loose shoelace trailing on the floor. She puts her box down so that she will not fall down while walking. I hold it steady as she ties the lace and checks the other shoe. Then we make sure the doorway is clear before lifting both boxes again. The work takes a little longer, but we finish without a dropped box or an injury.
